craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Naming as act: Māyā by name; power-only kept absolute (no other proved). Rejected: (a) explaining Māyā → killed: row 10, image stands. (b) softening only → killed: only is the proof. Read aloud: MĀ-yā BY-name, FROM-his-POW-er ON-ly … IS-made OF-non-SHOW-ing.

lines: Māyā by name, from his power only — no other proved:
this world-maker lordship is made of non-showing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyābhidās tacchakter eva cānyāprasiddhitaḥ tadakhyātimayaṃ hy etaj jagannirmātṛteśitā

reads_against.argmap: Whence Māyā and world-making? → Māyā from power alone, lordship from non-showing: no second cause survives.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
